mapper.insert: INSERT INTO youth_policy ( policy_no, policy_name, policy_keyword, policy_description, support_content, provider_institution_code, provider_institution_name, zip_cd, application_start_date, application_end_date, application_period_text, application_method, application_url, reference_url, min_age, max_age, income_condition_code, min_income, max_income, income_condition_text, qualification, synced_at ) VALUES ( #{policyNo}, #{policyName}, #{policyKeyword}, #{policyDescription}, #{supportContent}, #{providerInstitutionCode}, #{providerInstitutionName}, #{zipCd}, #{applicationStartDate}, #{applicationEndDate}, #{applicationPeriodText}, #{applicationMethod}, #{applicationUrl}, #{referenceUrl}, #{minAge}, #{maxAge}, #{incomeConditionCode}, #{minIncome}, #{maxIncome}, #{incomeConditionText}, #{qualification}, #{syncedAt} ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE policy_name = new.policy_name, policy_keyword = new.policy_keyword, policy_description = new.policy_description, support_content = new.support_content, provider_institution_code = new.provider_institution_code, provider_institution_name = new.provider_institution_name, zip_cd = new.zip_cd, application_start_date = new.application_start_date, application_end_date = new.application_end_date, application_period_text = new.application_period_text, application_method = new.application_method, application_url = new.application_url, reference_url = new.reference_url, min_age = new.min_age, max_age = new.max_age, income_condition_code = new.income_condition_code, min_income = new.min_income, max_income = new.max_income, income_condition_text = new.income_condition_text, qualification = new.qualification, synced_at = new.synced_at

mapper.select:
SELECT yp.youth_policy_id AS youthPolicyId, yp.policy_name AS policyName, yp.policy_keyword AS policyKeyword, yp.provider_institution_name AS providerInstitutionName, yp.application_start_date AS applicationStartDate, yp.application_end_date AS applicationEndDate, yp.application_period_text AS applicationPeriodText FROM youth_policy yp
ORDER BY yp.youth_policy_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT yp.youth_policy_id AS youthPolicyId, yp.policy_name AS policyName, yp.policy_keyword AS policyKeyword, yp.provider_institution_name AS providerInstitutionName, yp.application_start_date AS applicationStartDate, yp.application_end_date AS applicationEndDate, yp.application_period_text AS applicationPeriodText FROM youth_policy yp
ORDER BY yp.application_end_date IS NULL, yp.application_end_date ASC, yp.youth_policy_id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT yp.youth_policy_id AS youthPolicyId, yp.policy_name AS policyName, yp.policy_keyword AS policyKeyword, yp.policy_description AS policyDescription, yp.support_content AS supportContent, yp.provider_institution_name AS providerInstitutionName, yp.application_start_date AS applicationStartDate, yp.application_end_date AS applicationEndDate, yp.application_period_text AS applicationPeriodText, yp.min_age AS minAge, yp.max_age AS maxAge, yp.min_income AS minIncome, yp.max_income AS maxIncome, yp.income_condition_text AS incomeConditionText, yp.qualification AS qualification, yp.application_method AS applicationMethod, yp.application_url AS applicationUrl, yp.reference_url AS referenceUrl FROM youth_policy yp WHERE yp.youth_policy_id = #{youthPolicyId}
